from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import pandas as pd,json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_announced_treasury_qt_cap_path_v1'
assert not out.exists(), 'E15已存在，应继续现存阶段而非重新登记'
proposal_path=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_all_revision_prior_policy_sources_v1/next_experiment.json'
proposal=json.loads(proposal_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert proposal['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN'
date_path=root/'reports/research/510300_historical_fomc_transmission_v1/us_events_before_etf_returns.parquet'
dates=pd.read_parquet(date_path,columns=['Date'])
dates=pd.to_datetime(dates['Date']).dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d').tolist()
assert len(dates)==32 and len(set(dates))==32 and all(int(d[:4]) in [2022,2023,2024,2025] for d in dates)
assert {y:sum(d.startswith(str(y)) for d in dates) for y in range(2022,2026)}=={2022:8,2023:8,2024:8,2025:8}
reuse={
 '2022-03-16':'reports/research/510300_historical_fomc_transmission_v1/sources/20220316_声明.html',
 '2023-12-13':'reports/research/510300_historical_fomc_transmission_v1/sources/20231213_声明.html',
 '2024-07-31':'reports/research/510300_historical_fomc_transmission_v1/sources/20240731_声明.html',

}

assert len(links)==1 and links[0]['href']=='/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20251029a1.htm'

items.append({'source_id':'fed20251029_implementation','date':'2025-10-29','url':urljoin('https://www.federalreserve.gov',links[0]['href']),'kind':'implementation','reuse_path':None,'direct_link_source':reuse['2025-10-29']})
assert len(items)==34 and sum(x['reuse_path'] is not None for x in items)==8
inputs=[proposal_path,date_path,root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_all_revision_prior_policy_sources_v1/result.json',root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1/result.json',root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1/result.json']
